prompt: Objective: help a language-learning app double revenue. What you've learned: paying users are flat because new subscriptions equal cancellations. Latest finding: 60% of new subscribers cancel within their first month. What is the best next step?

options.text: Work out why new subscribers cancel within a month
options.feedback: Right. Cancellations cancel out every new subscriber, so early churn comes before spending more on acquisition.

options.text: Calculate the ad spend needed to double sign-ups
options.feedback: More sign-ups won't help while 60% of them leave within a month.

options.text: Compare prices with rival language apps
options.feedback: Price may turn out to be one reason people cancel, but start with why they cancel.

options.text: Size the market for live tutoring add-ons
options.feedback: A new product is a later lever. The finding is about churn.

explanation: 60% of new subscribers cancel within a month, so understanding early churn comes before growing acquisition.
